name: Capitalism Plus
description: 69 cards from the October 18, 2026 set. Draw, trade, and play your way.

cards.name: Almost
cards.text: Draw 4 cards. You cannot win this turn.

cards.name: Vice Versa
cards.text: Force someone to discard a card. You draw a card.

cards.name: Money Shuffling
cards.text: Discard all of your coins. For each coin discarded, draw a card or make someone discard a card.

cards.name: Confuse
cards.text: Force someone to discard a friend or item.

cards.name: Heist
cards.text: Take as many cards from anywhere as you can get away with.

cards.name: Incognito
cards.text: Secretly look at someone else's hand.

cards.name: Fraud Fred
cards.text: Rearrange the top 5 cards of the draw pile in any order.

cards.name: Three Faced
cards.text: Split the draw pile into 2 piles. Everyone gets to choose which pile to draw from when drawing.

cards.name: Balanced Diet
cards.text: Discard your hand & shuffle the discard pile when played. You draw out of the discard pile.

cards.name: Rumors
cards.text: Force someone to discard all friend cards in their hand.

cards.name: Roast Fleast
cards.text: Everyone gives someone else a card. You can see all cards given.

cards.name: Double Eyed Cyclops
cards.text: Flip the ways the draw & discard pile are facing. Put this card into the draw pile.

cards.name: Bodyguard
cards.text: If someone makes you discard a card, instead discard this friend and draw a card.

cards.name: Mighty O
cards.text: Take a card of your choice from the draw or discard pile.

cards.name: Vegas
cards.text: If you have over 4 cards in your hand, put your hand shuffled into the draw pile. Draw 5 cards.

cards.name: Introduction
cards.text: Give any number of your active friends to someone else.

cards.name: Seal the Deal
cards.text: On your turn, a trade between any players must be made.

cards.name: Investment
cards.text: When you draw a coin, draw an additional card with the extra card drawn.

cards.name: Cookie Jar
cards.text: Counts as 2 cards when active.

cards.name: Sharing is Caring
cards.text: Steal all coins.

cards.name: People's Choice Dictator
cards.text: All trades made must be approved by you.

cards.name: Recycle Diver
cards.text: Steal 2 cards from the discard pile.

cards.name: Jump the Gun
cards.text: Steal 2 cards from the draw pile.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.text: If you are forced to discard this card, draw up to the cards that were discarded this way.

cards.name: Proofread
cards.text: If someone is wanting to make a trade with you, look at the card(s) they are offering. 2 uses.

cards.name: Crying Always Works
cards.text: Make all other friends your friends.

cards.name: Flowers
cards.text: Take a card from the draw & discard pile.

cards.name: Sleep
cards.text: Draw a card. If you draw a Friend, Item, Coin, or Secret, draw 3 more cards.

cards.name: Pain Brain
cards.text: Discard 2 cards. Draw 4 cards.

cards.name: Suggestions
cards.text: Force someone to do any possible action once.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.text: If this card is stolen the thief must give you a card.

cards.name: Disarm
cards.text: Play without your thumbs or give your hand away. Discard this card if you fail.

cards.name: Royal Reset
cards.text: Shuffle the draw & discard piles together. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Debris (Deh-briss)
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Return this card to your hand.

cards.name: Auction
cards.text: Force someone to give away their cards for a payment they will accept in game.

cards.name: Coin
cards.text: When drawn, place this in front of you face up and draw another card. This can be traded with anyone.

cards.name: Money
cards.text: Draw cards up to a number people can agree on. Put this card back in your hand.

cards.name: Piggy Bank
cards.text: Spend 1 coin to draw 1 card. Give this card to another player.

cards.name: Split
cards.text: Steal a card from both the draw & discard pile.

cards.name: Too Rich
cards.text: Draw up to 4 cards when this is played. You must discard a card when you draw a card.

cards.name: Snake Oil
cards.text: If you successfully give this card to someone, they discard 3/4 of their hand and this card.

cards.name: Positivity
cards.text: Smile forever or discard a card.

cards.name: Taxer Taxer
cards.text: Steal 1 card from someone.

cards.name: Refund
cards.text: Look at someone's hand & take back all the cards they ever stole from you this game.

cards.name: Fair & Square
cards.text: Steal a card from all opponents. Shuffle this card into the draw pile.

cards.name: Ten Hens
cards.text: Draw an additional card on your turn.

cards.name: Fraud
cards.text: Counts as 2 coins when active. Use to use the coins.

cards.name: Hand It Over
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Kindness of My Heart
cards.text: Steal 3 cards. Next turn, give one back.

cards.name: Magic Eye
cards.text: Look at a card on the top of the draw pile for each player. Rearrange those cards however you like.

cards.name: Lizard Pal
cards.text: Block a targeted card or steal 2 cards.

cards.name: Dictionary
cards.text: You must speak in a different language than the one you use the most.

cards.name: Round Down
cards.text: Make everyone (including you) discard 1/2 of their hand.

cards.name: Fortunate
cards.text: Choose an opponent secretly. If they talk next, steal a card from them & discard this card.

cards.name: Stem Cell
cards.text: Look at an opponent's hand. Steal a card from them.

cards.name: Nope
cards.text: Block an action. 2 uses.

cards.name: Italy
cards.text: Look at the top 3 cards in the draw pile. Put one in your hand.

cards.name: Fact Check
cards.text: Make someone discard the leftmost/rightmost card in their hand.

cards.name: My Mother
cards.text: All additional cards drawn by anyone on your turn must be revealed.

cards.name: Ignore
cards.text: Draw up to cards discarded from another card.

cards.name: Take Them Down With You
cards.text: Force someone to go down to 2 cards. You go down to 3 cards.

cards.name: Guard Cat
cards.text: You cannot draw or discard any cards outside of your turn.

cards.name: Emotional Maturity
cards.text: If someone tries to steal from you, discard a card and block the thievery.

cards.name: Crown
cards.text: Discard 2 cards in someone's hand. You discard 1 card.

cards.name: Give and Take
cards.text: Swap hands with someone.

cards.name: Encouraging Words
cards.text: This person cannot draw cards at the start of their turn for 2 turns.

cards.name: Canned Souls
cards.text: Double your card draw for a turn.

cards.name: Power Potions
cards.text: Everyone discards a card when first played. Decrease the minimum winning hand size to 9 cards.

cards.name: Quiet Mimes
cards.text: Make a strange noise 3 times until your next turn. If successful, take a card of your choice from an opponent or the draw pile.
